headline: Last session: Sensex surged 1,718 points to 81,028 and Nifty reclaimed 25,000 as bulls dominated D-Street.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Sunday, 8 November.

why: Indian equities bucked the global tech sell-off to record their best weekly performance in 6 years.
Strong buying in financial, auto, and banking stocks propelled benchmark indices to sharp gains.
Festive cheer and bullish sentiment ahead of Diwali supported broad market buying across sectors.
Sustained rally helped Sensex gain over 1,700 points and Nifty finish above the 25,000 milestone.
whatHappening: In the last trading session, Sensex rallied 1,718 points to close at 81,028 while Nifty ended at 25,030.
Indian stock markets closed out Samvat 2082 on a high note, posting massive two-day gains.
Brokerages released Samvat stock picks, highlighting top buy ideas like ICICI Bank, BEL, and Angel One.
Kwality Wall's reported Q2FY27 revenue growth of 44% alongside a net loss of ₹17 crore.
summary: In the last trading session, Indian benchmark indices witnessed a massive rally as Sensex surged 1,718 points to 81,028 and Nifty reclaimed 25,000. Indian equities bucked a global tech sell-off to post their best weekly performance in six years ahead of Diwali. Top brokerage stock picks for the festive season included ICICI Bank, BEL, and Angel One.
